Rhein Kraft watched the Takarazuka Kinen 
on-site, witnessing the very moment Sweep 
Tosho seized victory.

A Tiara Umamusume defeats the heavyweights 
of the Classic Triple Crown route. 
Inspired by this unprecedented feat, she 
senses new possibilities for Tiara 
Umamusume.

Furthermore, Cesario emerged victorious in 
an American GⅠ. Line Craft couldn't 
contain her excitement over this historic 
first achievement in the Japanese racing 
world.

With our own hands, we are expanding the 
future for Tiara Umamusume. Rhein Kraft 
felt that with absolute certainty.

—Meanwhile, Air Messiah felt a growing 
sense of impatience seeing her peers leave 
their hoofprints in history...
